## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a spec clause in `docs/spec.md`, or it needs none.
- [ ] A test fails without the change and passes with it.
- [ ] `make check` passes, including the docs-integrity test.
- [ ] Every guide that describes the old behaviour is updated.
- [ ] Commits are atomic, use Conventional Commits, and cite IDs in `Refs:`.
- [ ] No new `//nolint` without a reason on the same line.
